_network_mode_doc: ISOLATED BY DEFAULT, and this is the copy that actually decides it. The 2026-07-27 operator decision was written into executor/api/config.json's network_config_defaults.mode (see its _network_default_doc), but create_vm reads network_mode from HERE — so the decision never took effect on the tool path, and every agent-created VM got `-netdev user` (QEMU slirp = outbound internet) for three days while the api-side config claimed otherwise. That is the exact hole the decision was made to close. Two defaults for one fact is the defect; until they are consolidated, THESE TWO VALUES MUST BE CHANGED TOGETHER. Reaching NAT or bridge is a deliberate, separately-confirmed act: pass network_mode explicitly.
